title: THA–UNICEF Strategic Meeting on Hepatitis B Birth-Dose Vaccination
excerpt: Tanzania Health Alliance (THA) recently convened a strategic meeting with UNICEF Tanzania to advance national efforts toward introducing Hepatitis B birth-dose vaccination.
content: Tanzania Health Alliance (THA) recently convened a strategic meeting with UNICEF Tanzania to advance national efforts toward introducing Hepatitis B birth-dose vaccination. This strategic partnership aims to strengthen vaccination programs and save lives through early intervention.
author: THA Communications Team

title: Why Viral Hepatitis Awareness Still Matters in Tanzania
excerpt: On the morning of 16 February 2026, the Executive Director of Tanzania Health Alliance (THA) participated in a national radio discussion highlighting the critical importance of Hepatitis awareness.
content: On the morning of 16 February 2026, the Executive Director of Tanzania Health Alliance (THA) participated in a national radio discussion highlighting the critical importance of Hepatitis awareness. With thousands of cases remaining undiagnosed, continued awareness efforts are essential to detecting and treating cases early.
author: THA Communications Team

title: Tanzania Health Alliance Hosts Youth Mental Health Session in Partnership with ActionAid Tanzania
excerpt: Tanzania Health Alliance (THA), in partnership with ActionAid Tanzania, successfully hosted a youth-focused mental health session under the Life Unlocked program.
content: Tanzania Health Alliance (THA), in partnership with ActionAid Tanzania, successfully hosted a youth-focused mental health session under the Life Unlocked program. The session brought together young people to discuss mental well-being, resilience-building, and peer support during challenging life transitions.
author: THA Communications Team

title: Supporting Mental Health Among Postgraduate Researchers at DUCE
excerpt: Tanzania Health Alliance (THA) participated in a mental health workshop for postgraduate students at the Dar es Salaam University College of Education (DUCE).
content: Tanzania Health Alliance (THA) participated in a mental health workshop for postgraduate students at the Dar es Salaam University College of Education (DUCE). The workshop addressed the unique mental health challenges faced by researchers and provided resources for support.
author: THA Communications Team

title: THA Leads Advocacy for Hepatitis B Birth Dose Introduction in Tanzania
excerpt: Tanzania Health Alliance (THA) is excited to be a leading partner in a strategic collaboration with the Coalition for Global Hepatitis B Control.
content: Tanzania Health Alliance (THA) is excited to be a leading partner in a strategic collaboration with the Coalition for Global Hepatitis B Control. This partnership aims to introduce Hepatitis B birth-dose vaccination as a critical intervention to prevent mother-to-child transmission.
author: THA Communications Team

title: Tanzania Health Alliance Leads Mass Awareness Campaign for World Hepatitis Testing Week
excerpt: Tanzania Health Alliance (THA) successfully hosted a mass awareness campaign to mark World Hepatitis Testing Week at Kigamboni College of Education.
content: Tanzania Health Alliance (THA) successfully hosted a mass awareness campaign to mark World Hepatitis Testing Week at Kigamboni College of Education. The campaign promoted widespread testing, education on prevention, and connected participants with healthcare resources.
